description: This file defines a test adapter class for Zend HTTP client, used for testing purposes by simulating HTTP responses without making real network requests.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Test
classes.description: A testing adapter for Zend HTTP client that simulates HTTP responses for testing purposes.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration array for the adapter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Simulates connecting to a remote server (dummy implementation).

methods.name: write
methods.description: Builds and returns an HTTP request string based on input parameters.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns the next response in the response buffer.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response(s) to be returned by this adapter.

methods.name: addResponse
methods.description: Adds a response to the response buffer.

methods.name: setResponseIndex
methods.description: Sets the position of the response buffer for the next read.
